title: Raven Character Loader — presence engine + universal adapter → runnable embodiment stack
objective: Write a single runnable Python module that loads a character (Raven) into a body via the universal adapter HAL. It must: (1) import the existing PresenceEngine from brain/presence_engine.py; (2) import the universal adapter layer from adapters/ (get_adapter, frame_from_presence); (3) provide a load_character(name, platform) function that instantiates the engine, binds a BodyAdapter, and returns an object with .express(expression) and .status() methods; (4) run end-to-end when executed (a demo that loads 'raven' and expresses 'warmth', 'delight', 'curious', 'boundary' via the blender adapter and prints the result). Keep it self-contained and runnable with `python3 <module>.py`.
